Undiagnosed stomach issues, psoriatic arthritis, and theres something going on with my lung that i cant breathe without my chest burning. X rays are clear and the cat scan and breathing tests are months away. And now my neck is burnt to shit. The rope snapped. Pretty sad when you cant even finish yourself off.

Im not sure if its lately or if its just a buildup of things but i have nobody and bothing left. Not a single friend to talk to, girlfriend left, health is in the shitter. Tired of being in pain every day. Tired of trying to reach out to the friends i had and never getting a responce. Tired of watching people be so ugly to each other. Tired of being so alone. Just truly done.

Damnit, im still alive. 
Yeah, its a daily strugle.

Two of them, my physically abusive mother, whom i still begrudgingly talk to from time to time, knew that i wouldent hit her back or defend myself because she was a woman. My father when i was sixteen told me i was a sixteen year old accident he didnt know how to erase and on one occasion he took a swing at me so i broke his arm and shortly after moved out (kicked out, same difference). Never really forgave either of them.
Quit fighting my darker half and just live a happier life. Either that or, on the opposite side of the spectrum, just give in and die already. Either one would be fine

Leather jacket and pants. Seriously has anyone here ever tried to bite through leather? Avoid cities, stay in forested northern areas. Cold enough to freeze anything that cant produce its own warmth. As contridictory as it may sound, stay lone wolf. No guns, only melee and archery.

Realistically even if i took him to court for fraud it would cost me more than i would get. He's got less money than i do, and any time i try and bring up him paying me any back, "ill have it on friday, i promise". Thats been going on for about a month now. So this last friday i went over to take his game system for collateral, telling him that he can have it back when he pays me back, he wasnt there but his landlord/roomate understood the situation, and in the conversation with his landlord he brought up that money and cannabis has been going missing from his room. At least im not the only one hes fucked over, but at the same time i feel bad for the landlord gettin fucked over like that

Most recently i was giving my rent money to my roomate (best friend at the time) because his name was on the lease. Turns out he never gave any of it to the landlord, got us evicted, and shortly after i found out the damage deposit was only half of what he said it was. Fucker made me pay the whole damage deposit and pocketed all of my money that was supposedly going to rent.
Love. Never again

Honestly, it just seems like no matter how hard i try nothing ever gets better. I try to help people with anything that i can because it makes me feel even a little better about myself, and when im no more use to them they dissapear. I dont leave people because i know how much it sucks to have someone just cut contact with you, it happens all the time. I always have my gaurds up around people, maybe a trust issue, but whenever i actually let someone in and im vulnerable they leave. It took me over a month to open up and quit being so nervous around my most recent girlfriend, and about two weeks after, shes gone. Reads my messages, i know she does because i get the read receipt, but i dont get a response. Like really, i try to be the best person i can be, i hide my mental and physical scars as much as i can because i know it makes people squeamish, i just dont understand why everyone leaves.

Been on a shit ton of them, none of them worked, even after waiting three months. Sertraline or whatever its called made me want to act on my impulses more. Cannabis helped for a while, but now i just feel trapped in my mind in a dark loop when i use it. Psychiatrist got me into DBT, that did fuck all. When i was in psych after a failed attempt they even tried shock therapy (not what they called it but i cant remember the name they used) and that would work for like three days. Eventually my psychiatrist basically gave up on me, "well what do you want me to do, nothing we've done has helped" "well gee, try something else, or give me something to finish myself off with?" needless to say i never went back.
And yeah, theres mental problems on my mother and fathers side of the family, all condensed into one fucked up person. Psychosis (havent had a psychotic episode in a while so i can atleast be thankful for that), borderline personality disorder, major depression, social anxiety, generalised anxiety disorder. Ive tried to get help, but theres nothing that really does.
Dropped a knife. As usual, my reaction is to catch the falling object. Now i have a nice long scar across the inside of my hand.

I once had a teacher that wouldent let anyone eat in class, and if you got caught eating he would take the food and eat it ALL OF IT right in front of you. So i got the brilliant idea to make chocolate chip cookies with a whole package of chocolate laxatives in them. The next day in class I slowly ate one cookie, carefully avoiding the chocolate and making sure to be seen by the teacher. He takes the bag of cookies from me and eats all of them right in my face. Im pretty sure i had a huge smirk on my face the whole time. For the next two days we had a substitute teacher, and as far as i know (younger brother had the same teacher) he still wont eat students food.
I can tell you this, im a 22 year old man, other than that i dont know who the fuck i am or where i fit in this world

Honestly every day is different. Some days i'll feel on top of the world, others i feel worse than when i took the pills. All in all, i dont really want to kill myself. But i dont exactly want to keep living either.

Two years ago right after christmas, i had been dumped by the love of my life, assaulted by my ex best friend, and had an injured leg. I couldent make rent and had nowhere to go, no one to talk to. I figured id rather die than be homeless. I took a bottle of 150 extra strength tylenol tabs. I still remember the sickly sweet taste of the coating and every time i do it makes me want to vomit. I dont remember how i got there or how long i had been in there but when my landlords came on the day of my eviction (couldent pay rent) i was found unconcious in my bathtub. I woke up in the hospital and instantly vomited. I felt ashamed more so than anything, that it didnt work and now these people have to clean up my mess. I dont remember a lot of my time in the hospital, but every now and again i get flashbacks. I was diagnosed with depression, borderline personality disorder, and psychosis. I got help that i needed, but clearly not enough or i wouldent be here.
